items.titleZh: 维斯塔潘认为队友差距缩小源于赛车“更易驾驶”，斯特拉持不同意见

items.originalTitle: 维斯塔潘称队友差距缩小因赛车“更易驾驶”，斯特拉持不同意见
items.summaryEn: Max Verstappen believes the smaller gaps between team-mates in 2026 are down to this generation of cars being easier to drive on the limit, a view McLaren team boss Andrea Stella disagrees with. Liam Lawson and Yuki Tsunoda both impressed in one-off outings at Zandvoort.
detailZh: 马克斯·维斯塔潘：车队内部队友之间差距变小是因为赛车更“好开”，而安德烈亚·斯特拉对此持不同意见
随着利亚姆·劳森和角田裕毅在F1荷兰大奖赛上分别为各自车队带来令人印象深刻的替补出场表现，马克斯·维斯塔潘认为2026年的赛车让队友之间更容易保持接近的差距
红牛车队的马克斯·维斯塔潘认为，2026年队友之间差距之所以很小，是因为这一代赛车在极限驾驶时更容易掌控，而迈凯伦车队领队安德烈亚·斯特拉则给出了不同的看法。
在赞德沃特，利亚姆·劳森为红牛车队临时顶替受伤的伊萨克·哈贾尔出赛，排位赛获得第八名，仅比维斯塔潘慢0.1秒。与此同时，替补车手角田裕毅在劳森的小红牛赛车上同样表现出色，在这位日本车手2026年的首个比赛周末中，与车队正选车手阿维德·林德布拉德的差距也在0.1秒左右。
当被问到这些微小的差距是否意味着车手现在更难发挥决定性作用时，这位荷兰车手回答道：“我认为尤其是在排位赛中。现在的这些赛车要找到极限容易多了，因为在不少地方你的电量也会稍微低一些。一切都变得更容易对齐。
我认为这个周末相比之前的赛车很好地展示了这一点。对我来说，这并不意外。
维斯塔潘并非有意贬低队友们的努力，他说劳森这个周末“干得非常扎实”，而这位新西兰车手则解释说，现在的红牛赛车感觉远不像问题重重的前任赛车那样处于刀锋边缘。
但维斯塔潘确实认为赞德沃特延续了整个围场一整年的趋势。“我认为整个赛季你都能看到这一点。每个人始终都在十分之一、十分之二秒之内。如果你的排位赛非常糟糕，那就是十分之三秒。差距总是非常小，”他解释道。“你也能从角田身上看到这一点，他一上来就在那里。”
不过，维斯塔潘的观点并非得到普遍认同。迈凯伦领队安德烈亚·斯特拉认为，这一代赛车依然很难驾驭，因为2026年动力单元规则在座舱内常规驾驶要求的基础上，又增加了一层复杂性。
"我不知道其他车队的情况，但我们的两位车手都把这些赛车归类为难开的车，"斯特拉说。"可以肯定的是，去年两位车手之间的差距要小得多。而在这里，一旦某位车手状态稍有落后，差距就可能很大。
"这些赛车难开有多个原因。赛季初，难点在弯道，后来又在直道。弯道的难点在于抓地力低、下压力少得多、轮胎更小；直道的难点在于能量输出的不稳定，或者你可能临近刹车时突然出现超级打滑（superclip），导致失去了刹车参照点。又或者有时令人沮丧的是，你更早开了油门，结果之后能量输出反而损失了。所以说，从多个角度来看，驾驶今年的赛车都更困难。
虽然斯特拉承认车手和他们的工程师在驾驭动力单元方面已经熟练得多，但他表示与底盘相关的挑战依然存在。"即使所有车队都增加了下压力，车手仍然很难预测刹车时会出什么问题，或者赛车在加速出弯时会不会突然甩尾，"他指出。
“使用上一代赛车时，空气动力学负荷要大得多，轮胎的抓地力也强得多，所以更容易。”
detailEn: Max Verstappen: Smaller team-mate gaps are down to "easier" cars as Andrea Stella disagrees

As Liam Lawson and Yuki Tsunoda impress on one-off outings with their respective teams at Formula 1's Dutch Grand Prix, Max Verstappen thinks the 2026 cars are making it easier for team-mates to stay close

Red Bull's Max Verstappen thinks the narrow gaps between team-mates in 2026 are being helped by this generation of cars being easier to drive on the limit, with McLaren team boss Andrea Stella offering a different view.

At Zandvoort Liam Lawson qualified eighth, one tenth behind Verstappen, on a one-off outing for Red Bull to deputise for the injured Isack Hadjar. Meanwhile, reserve driver Yuki Tsunoda also impressed in Lawson's Racing Bulls car, conceding a similar gap to the team's regular driver Arvid Lindblad on the Japanese driver's first race weekend of 2026.

Asked whether those narrow gaps suggested drivers now have less opportunity to make the difference, the Dutchman replied: "Especially in qualifying, I think. It's a lot easier nowadays with these cars to find the limit, because in quite a few places you're also a bit down on battery. Everything becomes a bit easier to line up.
"I think that demonstrated it quite well this weekend compared to the previous cars. For me, that's not a surprise."

Verstappen didn't mean to diminish the work of his teammates, saying Lawson had done "a very solid job this weekend", while the New Zealander explained the current Red Bull felt much less on a knife-edge than its troubled predecessor.

But Verstappen did feel Zandvoort continued a year-long  paddock-wide trend. "I think you see it already the whole season. Everyone is always within one tenth, two tenths. If you have a very bad qualifying, three tenths. The margins are always super small," he explained. "You can also see that with Yuki, he's right there straight away."

Verstappen's view isn't universally shared, though. McLaren chief Andrea Stella felt the current generation of cars was still difficult to drive, because the 2026 power unit regulations have added another layer of complexity on top of the usual driving requirements in the cockpit.

"I don't know about others, but these cars are classified by both our drivers as difficult cars to drive," Stella said. "Definitely, last year we could see much less scatter between the two drivers. Here when a driver is a bit on the back foot then this can be a large amount.

"They are difficult cars to drive for several reasons. At the start of the season, it was in the corners and then in the straights. In the corners because of the low grip, much less downforce, smaller tyres and in the straights because of the inconsistencies of the deployment or the fact that you may have a sudden superclip before braking and now you've lost your braking reference. Or sometimes the frustrating element is that you go on power earlier and now you're losing deployment later. So, there were several angles from which driving this year's car was more difficult.

While Stella conceded drivers and their engineers have become much more adept at handling the power units, he said the chassis related challenges are still intact. "Even if all teams have added downforce, it's very difficult for the drivers to predict what the problem is going to be in braking or whether or not the car will snap in traction," he pointed out.
"With the previous generation of cars there was much, much more load aerodynamically and much more grip from the tyres, and it was easier."

items.titleZh: 维斯塔潘认为替补车手出色表现暴露F1问题
items.summaryZh: 在荷兰大奖赛上，替补车手利亚姆·劳森和角田裕毅表现亮眼，四届世界冠军维斯塔潘暗示这表明2026年的F1变得过于简单。
items.originalTitle: 维斯塔潘认为替补车手的出色表现暴露了F1的某些问题
items.summaryEn: Strong stand-in performances by Liam Lawson and Yuki Tsunoda at the Dutch Grand Prix prompted Max Verstappen to suggest that Formula 1 has become too easy in 2026.
detailZh: 利亚姆·劳森和角田裕毅在荷兰大奖赛上相当不错的替补表现，是否证明了2026年的F1变得太容易了？
四届世界冠军马克斯·维斯塔潘在排位赛后的暗示似乎正是如此——他那担任替补的红牛队友劳森只比他慢了0.115秒。
角田裕毅在小红牛接替了劳森，在本周末之前仅用一天模拟器工作熟悉过VCARB-03，从未实际驾驶过2026年的赛车，而他在第二节排位赛中只比小红牛的正赛车手阿维德·林德布拉德慢0.102秒。
维斯塔潘认为，这证明了这些赛车在排位赛中达到极限要容易得多，因为其独特的能量管理需求削弱了那种大胆激进、寸土必争的单圈冲刺的重要性——这让维斯塔潘以及排位赛专家夏尔·勒克莱尔这样的车手感到沮丧。
“尤其是在排位赛中，我认为现在的这些赛车要找到极限要容易得多，因为在不少地方你的电量会有所不足，一切都变得更容易把控，”当被问到劳森和角田之间的差距是否证明车手们今年能起的作用变小时，维斯塔潘这样说道。
“我认为与之前的赛车相比，这个周末很好地展示了这一点。对我来说，这并不意外。”
“整个赛季你已经能看到，所有人都始终在十分之一秒、十分之二秒的差距之内。”
“如果你的排位赛非常糟糕，那就是十分之三秒。差距总是很小的。”
劳森与维斯塔潘在单圈上的差距：荷兰大奖赛
劳森对2026款红牛福特动力单元非常熟悉，因为这款动力单元全年都在为他的小红牛提供动力，但在赞德沃特之前他从未驾驶过红牛小红牛22。
取他在赞德沃特两节排位赛中与维斯塔潘差距的平均值，得到0.245秒，这与伊萨克·哈贾尔2026赛季至今与维斯塔潘的平均差距（0.232秒）非常接近，尽管后者的样本量要大得多。
哈贾尔这个差距明显低于自2018年里卡多成为维斯塔潘队友以来，任何红牛队友与维斯塔潘排位赛平均差距的水平。
但当然，这不一定全都要归功于新规则。哈贾尔今年干得非常出色，以至于红牛多年来第一次甚至都不去考虑它的二号车手。
而劳森在小红牛度过了一个精彩的赛季，所以他在一队的表现比2025年初要好，这也是说得通的。
不过维斯塔潘提出了一个有趣的假设。《The 比赛》网站（The 比赛），也就是埃德·斯特罗（Edd Straw）的每周车手排名，确实因此变得更难做了，因为今年更难把车手和赛车的表现区分开，从而对队友之间做出明确的判断。
像奥斯卡·皮亚斯特里这样的车手也抱怨说，“电脑的表现或失常”经常在决定排位赛的结果，所以车手手中掌握的主动权变少了。
从更宏观的角度看2026年与2025年队友之间的差距，10支车队中（不算新加入的凯迪拉克）有6支车队的队友间差距比去年缩小了。阿隆索和斯特罗尔之间平均0.303秒的差距是今年队内最大的差距，而2025年最大的差距是红牛车队维斯塔潘与角田裕毅之间的0.735秒。
不过也可能是因为维斯塔潘现在更难像以前那样碾压他的队友了，因为2025年第二大的差距只有0.453秒（拉塞尔对安东内利）。
尽管这些数据同样存在一些限定条件，比如汉密尔顿和安东内利相比艰难的2025年竞争力有所提升，而这未必与排位赛中更容易达到F1赛车的极限有关。再加上目前只跑完了半个赛季，所以这些差距还有很多时间可以缩小或拉大。
但根据迈凯伦车队领队安德烈亚·斯特拉的说法，以上这一切并不一定证明2026年的F1对车手来说更容易了。
“这两辆车被我们的两位车手——我不知道其他车队的情况——都归为难以驾驶的赛车，”当The 比赛向他提出这个话题时，斯特拉（Stella）如此说道。
“去年，两位车手之间的表现差距明显要小得多。而现在，一旦车手处于劣势状态，这个差距就可能非常巨大。
“这些车难以驾驶有多方面原因。赛季初，问题出在弯道上，后来又出现在直道上。弯道难是因为抓地力低、下压力少得多、轮胎更小；直道难是因为能量输出的不一致性，或者可能在刹车前突然出现一次动力骤降（superclip），导致你失去了刹车参考点，又或者有时令人沮丧的是，你在高速状态下过早地全油门，结果之后反而损失了能量输出的效果。
“所以说，驾驶今年的赛车在多个方面都更加困难。至于与动力单元相关的问题，我认为车手和工程师们现在已经更加熟悉了，已经逐渐适应了，也能够更好地应对这些问题。”
“不过，在这次排位赛的总结会上，车手们仍然提到动力单元表现中的一些因素，会影响他们极限推进时的稳定性。所以这个问题并没有完全消失，但比赛季开始时已经好多了。
“但与弯道和抓地力相关的原因依然存在。即使所有车队都增加了下压力，车手也很难预测刹车时会出现什么问题，或者赛车在出弯牵引时会不会突然失控。
“对于上一代赛车来说，空气动力学负荷要大得多，轮胎的抓地力也强得多，所以相对更容易驾驭。虽然当时对车手来说也很难，因为一切都发生得快得多，但比较容易的原因是通常你只需要应对一种状况。
“而在这里，从抓地力稳定性的角度来看，任何时候都可能发生很多事情，甚至还有对风的敏感性——在匈牙利，或是在这里，风都是重要因素之一，导致这里没有一位车手能在排位赛中跑出一圈干净的飞驰圈。”
当被问及维斯塔潘关于2026年一级方程式赛车对车手技术要求降低的评论时，斯特拉回答道：“我不太确定，真的不确定，如果我去评论另一支车队，那我的说法会不准确。
“如果我要基于我之前的说法，谈谈我在迈凯伦所了解的情况，我会说今年甚至更加困难。
“就像过去一样，比如2025年，你需要适应速度，适应一切发生得有多快。但今年你必须适应一个事实，就是你可能遇到任何类型的问题，因为赛车会打滑得很厉害。
“所以，这可能取决于赛车的特性，甚至取决于车手的特性。但如果我结合迈凯伦的经验来看，我认为今年更加困难。”
detailEn: Are the very respectable stand-in performances of Liam Lawson and Yuki Tsunoda at the Dutch Grand Prix evidence that Formula 1 has become too easy in 2026?
That’s certainly what four-time world champion Max Verstappen was hinting at after qualifying, where his stand-in Red Bull team-mate Lawson was just 0.115s slower than him.

Yuki Tsunoda, who replaced Lawson at Racing Bulls and hadn’t driven the 2026 cars with just a single day of simulator work aboard the VCARB-03 prior to this weekend, was just 0.102s off regular Racing Bulls driver Arvid Lindblad in Q2.

Verstappen thinks this is evidence of how much easier it is to get to the limit of these cars in qualifying, given their unique energy demands have taken the emphasis away from swashbuckling, elbows-out one-lap efforts - much to the frustration of drivers like Verstappen and qualifying specialist Charles Leclerc.

“Especially in qualifying, I think it's a lot easier nowadays with these cars to find the limit, because you're also in quite a few places where you're a bit down on battery and everything becomes a bit easier to land,” Verstappen said when asked if Lawson and Tsunoda’s gaps were evidence drivers can make less of a difference this year.
“I think that demonstrated quite well this weekend compared to the previous cars. For me, that's not a surprise.
“You see it already the whole season; everyone is always within one tenth, two tenths.
“If you have a very bad qualifying, three tenths. It's always the margins are small.”
Lawson’s one-lap gap to Verstappen: Dutch GP
Lawson is very familiar with the 2026 Red Bull Ford power unit, as it’s powered his Racing Bulls all year, but he’d never driven the Red Bull RB22 prior to Zandvoort.

Take an average of the gap to Verstappen from his two Zandvoort qualifying sessions and you get 0.245s, very close to Isack Hadjar’s average gap to Verstappen in 2026 so far (0.232s), albeit over a much bigger sample size.
That Hadjar gap is considerably lower than any average Red Bull team-mate qualifying gap to Verstappen since Daniel Ricciardo was his team-mate in 2018.

But of course that’s not necessarily all down to the new rules. Hadjar has done a sterling job this year, so much so that Red Bull isn’t even considering its number two driver for the first time in years.
And Lawson’s put in a stellar season with Racing Bulls, so his performing better in the senior team than he did at the start of 2025 also makes sense.

But Verstappen raises an interesting hypothesis. The Race, namely Edd Straw’s weekly driver rankings, have certainly been complicated by it being harder to separate the performance of the driver and car this year and make definitive intra-team judgements.
Drivers like Oscar Piastri have also complained that “computers behaving or misbehaving” are also often deciding qualifying sessions, so there’s less power in the driver’s hands.

Looking more generally at the gaps between team-mates in 2026 versus 2025, the gap between team-mates in six of the 10 teams (discounting newcomer Cadillac) has gotten smaller since last year. The average 0.303s gap between Fernando Alonso and Lance Stroll is the largest intra-team gap this year, compared to the largest of 2025, the 0.735s between Verstappen and Yuki Tsunoda at Red Bull.
Perhaps it is the case though that it’s harder for Verstappen to destroy his team-mates like before, given the next biggest 2025 gap was 0.453s (George Russell-Kimi Antonelli).

Although that data again has caveats, like Lewis Hamilton and Antonelli’s increased competitiveness versus difficult 2025s, that aren’t necessarily to do with it being easier to get to the limit of F1 cars in qualifying. Plus the fact only half a season’s complete so there's plenty of time for those gaps to close or widen.
But all of that is not necessarily evidence that things are easier for drivers in F1 2026, according to McLaren team boss Andrea Stella.
“These cars are classified by both our drivers - I don't know about the others - as difficult cars to drive,” Stella said when The Race put the topic to him.
“Definitely last year we could see much less scatter between the two drivers. Here, when a driver is a bit on the back foot, then this can be a large amount.

“They are difficult cars to drive for several reasons. At the start of the season, it was in the corners and then in the straights. In the corners because of the low grip, much less downforce, smaller tyres, and in the straights because of the inconsistencies of the deployment, or the fact that you may have a sudden superclip before braking and now you've lost your braking reference, or sometimes the frustrating element that you go on power early in high speed and now you're losing deployment later.

“So there were several angles from which driving this year's car was more difficult. Those related to the power unit, I would say that the drivers and the engineers are now more familiar with, have become more familiar with, and they are sort of more ready to cope with that.

“Still, in the debriefing of this qualifying, drivers refer to elements of the power unit behaviour which affect the consistency of pushing at the limit. So this is not completely gone, but it's much less than the start of the season.

“But the reason associated [with] the corners and the grip is still there. Even if all teams have added downforce, it's very difficult for the drivers to predict what the problem is going to be in braking, or whether the car will snap or not in traction.

“With the previous generation of cars, there was much, much more load aerodynamically and much more grip from the tyres, and it was easier. While it was difficult for the drivers because everything was happening much faster, it was easier because normally you had kind of one thing to cope [with].

“Here, there's a lot that can happen at any moment from a grip consistency point of view, or even sensitivity to the wind, which in Hungary, or here, played a major part in the fact that nobody here had a clean lap in qualifying.”

Asked about Verstappen’s comments that F1 2026 put less onus on drivers’ skill, Stella replied: “I'm not so sure, like I'm genuinely not sure, and I would be inaccurate if I commented for another team.
“If I comment for what I've understood at McLaren, based on what I said before, I would say that this year is even more difficult.

“Like in the past, like in 2025, you needed to get used to the speed, and how fast things were happening. But this year you have to get used to adapt to the fact that you can have any kind of problem, because the car slides a lot.
“So it's, maybe this may depend on car characteristics, or even the driver's characteristics. But if I consider the McLaren experience, I think it's more difficult this year.”

items.summaryZh: 乔治·拉塞尔在2026年F1夏季休赛期后回归，表示自己“更放松”，并力图缩小与梅赛德斯队友基米·安东内利的积分差距，目前安东内利领先第三名的拉塞尔56分。

items.originalTitle: 乔治·拉塞尔称“更放松” 2026年F1冠军之争基米·安东内利占优
items.summaryEn: George Russell has returned from the 2026 F1 summer break feeling "more relaxed" as he tries to claw back into the title fight against Mercedes team-mate Kimi Antonelli, who leads third-placed Russell by 56 points.
detailZh: 乔治·拉塞尔表示“更加放松”，因为2026年F1世界冠军的头衔现在掌握在基米·安东内利手中，看他是否会丢掉
这位梅赛德斯车手在2026年F1赛季下半程开局强劲，他赢得了荷兰大奖赛冲刺赛，并将在周日的正赛中从第二位发车
乔治·拉塞尔在2026年F1夏休期归来后感到“更加放松”，他正试图在这场与梅赛德斯队友基米·安东内利的车手总冠军争夺战中迎头赶上
这位积分榜领跑者在11轮比赛后领先排名第三的拉塞尔56分，还剩12轮比赛，法拉利的刘易斯·汉密尔顿位列第二，落后安东内利53分
本周末的荷兰大奖赛给了拉塞尔一个晚期反击的机会，他到目前为止表现出色，从杆位出发赢得了冲刺赛，而安东内利只拿到第四名。
拉塞尔的优势延续到了周六的排位赛，他在迈凯伦杆位得主兰多·诺里斯之后拿到第二，而沮丧的安东内利因为在1号弯的失误将从第三位发车。
“我只会一场比赛一场比赛地来看，”拉塞尔在赞德沃特说，“我不会离开这个周末就说所有问题都解决了。
“我确实认为在巴塞罗那那个周末之前我做了一些重大改变，正如我今天早上早些时候所说，我有几场不错的比赛，巴塞罗那和奥地利。然后银石和斯帕，我们遇到了动力单元（PU）的问题，布达佩斯则完全不是我这边有竞争力的一个周末。
兰多·诺里斯，迈凯伦；乔治·拉塞尔，梅赛德斯；安德烈亚·基米·安东内利，梅赛德斯。
“所以，我觉得这个赛季一直都不算顺利。由于我们遇到的种种问题，这个赛季无论如何都不算顺利。但我只是觉得，在休赛期之后，我整个人轻松多了。我觉得自己已经没有什么可失去的了。
“压力没有了。我只是要出去，享受比赛，我甚至不太觉得自己是在争斗。这不是我会输掉的东西，而是我要去赢得的东西。所以这就是我的心态，我觉得这会帮助我。我只是在享受驾驶。”
这个赛季显然没有像拉塞尔所期望的那样发展，在2026年规则改革开始时，由于他的梅赛德斯车队预期会占据统治地位，他原本是夺冠的大热门。
但他的队友、二年级车手安东内利凭借惊人的单圈速度占据了上风，已经拿下六个杆位，而两位车手在正赛中都不时遭遇霉运。
拉塞尔此前还表示，这些全新的2026年赛车很适合安东内利激进的驾驶风格，因此这位28岁的车手花了大半个赛季来调整自己更为流畅平稳的驾驶方式。
这就是为什么八月的夏休期对这位英国车手来说来得正是时候，他利用这段时间持续不断 地提升自己——尤其是在他认为冠军争夺战“远未结束”的情况下。
兰多·诺里斯（迈凯伦）、乔治·拉塞尔（梅赛德斯）
拉塞尔补充道：“很明显，基米这个赛季做得非常出色，而我们两个人的驾驶风格确实相当不同。”
“这一点去年就很明显，而现在这套车和这套轮胎非常适合他，我只是在尝试把类似的东西融入我的驾驶风格。”
“我把它形容为：如果你改变自己的高尔夫挥杆动作，在取得进步之前，你可能会先后退半步。”
“这个休赛期正好让我把这些心得放到脑海深处，来到这个周末，不用时刻盯着我想在车和轮胎上实现什么，而是心里清楚自己需要做到什么，然后更自由地去驾驶。”
“我真的、真的为此感到骄傲，因为这就像是在为我积累一个经验工具箱，它会让我在未来的几年里变得更加强大。
“谁知道呢，也许明年技术又会完全不同。这就是一级方程式的美妙之处和挑战所在。每一年都不一样。”
detailEn: George Russell "more relaxed" as F1 2026 title is Kimi Antonelli's to lose
The Mercedes driver has made a strong start to the second half of the 2026 F1 campaign, as he won the Dutch GP sprint and will start Sunday's race in second
George Russell has returned from the 2026 Formula 1 summer break feeling “more relaxed” as he attempts to claw back into the title fight against Mercedes team-mate Kimi Antonelli.
The championship leader holds a 56-point advantage over third-placed Russell, with Ferrari’s Lewis Hamilton sitting second and 53 behind Antonelli after 11 rounds with 12 remaining.
This weekend’s Dutch Grand Prix marks an opportunity for Russell to stage a late bid and he has done well so far, winning the sprint race from pole while Antonelli only took fourth.
Russell’s advantage continued into Saturday’s qualifying as he took second behind McLaren polesitter Lando Norris, while a frustrated Antonelli is starting third after a mistake at Turn 1.
“I’m just going to take it race by race,” said Russell at Zandvoort. “I’m not going to come away from this weekend and say all issues are resolved.

“I do think I made some big changes going into the Barcelona weekend, and as I said earlier this morning, I had some good races, Barcelona and Austria. Then Silverstone and Spa, we had the PU issue, and Budapest was just not a competitive weekend on my side.
Lando Norris, McLaren, George Russell, Mercedes, Andrea Kimi Antonelli, Mercedes

“So, I think it just hasn’t been a clean run this season. It has not been a clean season whatsoever with all of the issues that we’ve had. But I just feel, I think after the break, I just feel way more relaxed. I don’t feel like I’ve got anything to lose.

“The pressure’s off. I’m just going to go out, enjoy it, and I don’t even really feel in a fight. It’s not mine to lose, it’s mine to gain. So that’s the mentality I’ve got, and I feel it’s going to help me. I’m just enjoying driving.”
This season has obviously not gone as hoped for Russell, who started the 2026 regulation switch as the heavy title favourite thanks to his Mercedes team expecting to dominate.
But his sophomore team-mate has enjoyed the upper hand thanks to his blistering one-lap pace with six poles, while misfortune has hit both drivers at times during a grand prix.
Russell also previously claimed that these new 2026 cars suit Antonelli’s aggressive driving style, so the 28-year-old has spent much of the year adapting his more smooth approach.
That is why the August summer break came at a good time for the Briton, who used it to continually keep developing - especially when he thinks the title fight is “far from over”.
Lando Norris, McLaren, George Russell, Mercedes
“Obviously Kimi’s been doing an amazing job this season, and clearly the two of us have quite different driving styles,” added Russell.
“That was apparent last year, and it is really working well for him with this car and these tyres and just trying to implement something similar into my driving style.
“I describe it as if you change your golf swing, you’ll probably take half a step back before making those improvements.

“The break just allowed me to put those learnings into the back of my mind, come here this weekend, not fixating on what I want to try and achieve with the car and the tyres, but knowing in the back of my head what I need to achieve and just drive more freely.
“I’m really, really proud of that because it’s just sort of building that toolbox of experience for me that’s going to allow me to be even better in the years to come.
“Who knows, maybe next year the technique is totally different again. That’s the beauty and challenge of Formula 1. Every year it’s different.”

items.originalTitle: 维斯塔潘患“流感样”疾病，赞德福特赛道暴露红牛根本问题
items.summaryEn: Verstappen admitted after qualifying that he is feeling unwell with flu-like symptoms, while Red Bull's RB22 exposed fundamental weaknesses at Zandvoort, leaving him seventh on the grid, more than four tenths behind polesitter Norris.
detailZh: 维斯塔潘患“流感样”疾病，赞德福特暴露红牛根本问题
这位红牛车手表示自己感觉并未完全恢复，主要期待能睡一觉——而据这位荷兰车手所说，赞德福特也暴露了小红牛22的一些根本性局限。
自2021年荷兰大奖赛回归赛历以来，马克斯·维斯塔潘已三次夺冠，他已然可以回顾一段非常成功的时期。但2026年的最后一届赛事迄今为止却成了一场煎熬，无论是红牛的速度还是维斯塔潘的身体状况都是如此。
“我以前感觉更好过，是的，”维斯塔潘在排位赛后于围场举行的荷兰媒体发布会上承认。“我感觉有点流感样症状，就是没有平常那么有精力。”
当被问及这是否也影响他驾驶时的表现时，他继续说道：“不，我不这么认为。我觉得一旦坐进车里，其实就没事了。”
但这确实意味着维斯塔潘正在以某种不同的方式经历他的最后一场主场比赛，他主要期待能休息的那一刻：“当然，我仍然享受看台上所有的车迷，但除此之外，我主要期待能睡一觉。”
为什么赞德福特暴露了红牛的一些根本性问题
除了维斯塔潘的身体状况，红牛在这条沙丘中的赛道上也在为性能苦苦挣扎。这位主场英雄只能接受排位第七，在排位赛中落后杆位得主兰多·诺里斯超过0.4秒。
“冲刺赛后我们对赛车做了相当多的调整，但没有任何效果，”维斯塔潘在接受Autosport采访时说。
据维斯塔潘所说，赞德福特赛道以夸张的方式暴露了红牛的一些弱点。
“赛车的平衡是最大的问题。它在整个弯道中就是不一致，但整个赛季都是这样。只是在某些赛道上比其他赛道稍微更糟一些。”
在这方面，赞德福特是一条比大多数赛道都更能暴露小红牛22弱点的赛道。
“这有时取决于路面，但也取决于赛道布局。这条赛道肯定不是最适合我们的布局，但我们就是需要努力解决它。我们可以猜测哪条赛道可能会稍微好一点，但我们需要尝试把它彻底消除。”
维斯塔潘补充说，在他看来，这与调校关系不大，因为红牛在这方面已经尝试了一切：“我认为我们现在只是更多地受限于赛车的一些根本性问题，这些是我们需要解决的。
“在这条赛道上也有一些高速弯，我们在那里也很吃力。总的来说，如果你没有好的平衡，你就无法真正攻击弯道。如果你也没有牵引力，你就无法正常出弯，所以所有这些都会损失时间。”
这意味着维斯塔潘认为在正常情况下，第七名是周日所能取得的最好结果，尤其是在没有下雨引发混乱的情况下。
如果没有雨，维斯塔潘认为第七名就是他在最后一场主场比赛中所能期望的最好结果。
这可能不是他所希望的赞德福特告别方式，尽管这位四届世界冠军强调，荷兰大奖赛时代整体上已经是一个巨大的成功。
“这绝对是一个时代的终结，”他说。“拥有自己的主场比赛，并且能够几次赢得它，是非常特别的。当然，它要离开了，这很遗憾，但另一方面，它也给了我很多伟大的时刻和回忆。”
是否还会再添一个难忘的时刻仍有待观察，但维斯塔潘最后采取了务实的态度。
“我真的只有在我们获胜时才满意，但明天那会非常困难，”他说。“整个赛季我们都稍微太慢了，这在赞德福特不会突然改变，但我们就是会努力最后一次享受它。”
detailEn: Verstappen suffering from "flu-like" illness as Zandvoort exposes Red Bull's fundamental problems

The Red Bull driver says he is not feeling completely fit and is mainly looking forward to getting some sleep - while Zandvoort also exposes some fundamental limitations of the RB22, according to the Dutch driver

With three victories since the Dutch Grand Prix returned to the calendar in 2021, Max Verstappen can already look back on a very successful period. The final edition in 2026 has proven an ordeal so far, both in terms of Red Bull’s pace and Verstappen’s physical condition.
"I've felt better before, yes," Verstappen admitted during the Dutch media session in the paddock after qualifying. "I feel a bit flu-like and I’m just not feeling as much energy as normal."
Asked whether that also affects his performance behind the wheel, he continued: "No, I don’t think so. I think once you’re in the car, it’s actually fine."

It does mean Verstappen is experiencing his final home race somewhat differently and is mainly looking forward to the moment he can get some rest: "Of course I still enjoy all the fans in the grandstands, but apart from that, I’m mostly looking forward to getting some sleep."
Why Zandvoort exposes some fundamental Red Bull problems

Aside from Verstappen’s physical condition, Red Bull is also struggling for performance at the circuit in the dunes. The home hero had to settle for seventh on the grid and was more than four tenths behind polesitter Lando Norris in qualifying.
"We changed quite a lot on the car after the sprint, but none of it made any difference," Verstappen said when asked by Autosport.
According to Verstappen, the Zandvoort circuit exposes some of Red Bull’s weaknesses to an exaggerated degree
"The balance of the car is the biggest problem. It’s just not consistent throughout the entire corner, but it has been like that all season. It’s just a little worse at some circuits than at others."
In that respect, Zandvoort is a track that exposes the RB22’s weaknesses more than most.

"It depends on the tarmac sometimes, but also on the layout of the track. This one is for sure not our best layout, but we just need to work on it. We can guess on what track it might be a little bit better, but we need to try and just dial it out."

Verstappen added that, in his view, it is not so much related to set-up, as Red Bull has tried everything in that respect: "I think we’re now simply more limited by some fundamental problems with the car that we need to solve.

"At this circuit you also have some fast corners and we’re lacking there as well. In general, if you don’t have a good balance, you can’t really attack the corners. And if you don’t have traction either, you can’t get out of the corners properly, so all of that costs time."
It means Verstappen considers seventh place the maximum achievable result on Sunday under normal circumstances, particularly if there is no chaos caused by rain.
Without rain, Verstappen reckons that P7 will be the best he can hope for in his final home race
It may not be the Zandvoort farewell he had hoped for, although the four-time world champion stresses that the Dutch GP era as a whole has already been a great success.

"It’s absolutely the end of an era," he said. "To have had your own home race and to have been able to win it a few times is very special. Of course, it’s a shame that it’s going away, but on the other hand, it has also given me a lot of great moments and memories."
Whether another memorable moment will be added remains to be seen, but Verstappen took a pragmatic view in conclusion.

"I’m really only satisfied when we win, but that’s going to be very difficult tomorrow," he said. "We’ve been a little too slow throughout this season and that’s not suddenly going to change in Zandvoort, but we’re just going to try to enjoy it one last time."

在这方面，赞德福特是一条比大多数赛道都更能暴露小红牛22弱点的赛道。
“这有时取决于路面，但也取决于赛道布局。这条赛道肯定不是对我们最有利的布局，但我们只需要继续努力。我们可以猜测在哪些赛道上情况可能会稍好一些，但我们仍需尝试把它的问题解决掉。”
维斯塔潘补充说，在他看来，这跟调校关系不大，因为红牛在这方面已经尝试了所有办法：“我认为我们现在只是更多地受到赛车一些根本性问题的限制，这些问题我们需要解决。”
“在这条赛道上还有一些快速弯角，而我们在这些地方同样有所欠缺。总的来说，如果你没有良好的平衡性，你就无法真正全力攻弯。而且如果你也没有足够的牵引力，你就无法顺利出弯，所以这一切都会损失时间。”
这意味着维斯塔潘认为，在正常情况下，尤其是如果没有雨水造成混乱的话，周日能取得的最好成绩就是第七名。
维斯塔潘认为，如果没有降雨，在他这场告别主场赛中，第七名可能就是他能期望的最好结果了。
这可能不是他所希望的赞德沃特告别战，尽管这位四届世界冠军强调，荷兰大奖赛的整个时代总的来说已经是一次巨大的成功。
“这绝对是一个时代的结束，”他说，“能够拥有属于自己的主场大奖赛，并且能在那里赢下几次，是非常特别的。当然，很遗憾它将告别赛历，但另一方面，它也给我带来了许多美好的时刻和回忆。”
是否还会再增添一个难忘的时刻仍是未知数，但维斯塔潘最后以一种务实的态度看待这一切。
"说实话，只有当我们赢的时候我才真正满意，但明天想赢会非常困难，"他说。"整个赛季以来我们都有些太慢了，这种情况在赞德沃特不会突然改变，但我们只想着最后再享受一次。"
detailEn: Max Verstappen feeling "flu-like" as Zandvoort exposes Red Bull's fundamental problems

The Red Bull driver says he is not feeling completely fit and is mainly looking forward to getting some sleep - while Zandvoort also exposes some fundamental limitations of the RB22, according to the Dutch driver

With three victories since the Dutch Grand Prix returned to the calendar in 2021, Max Verstappen can already look back on a very successful period. The final edition in 2026 has proven an ordeal so far, both in terms of Red Bull’s pace and Verstappen’s physical condition.
"I've felt better before, yes," Verstappen admitted during the Dutch media session in the paddock after qualifying. "I feel a bit flu-like and I’m just not feeling as much energy as normal."
Asked whether that also affects his performance behind the wheel, he continued: "No, I don’t think so. I think once you’re in the car, it’s actually fine."

It does mean Verstappen is experiencing his final home race somewhat differently and is mainly looking forward to the moment he can get some rest: "Of course I still enjoy all the fans in the grandstands, but apart from that, I’m mostly looking forward to getting some sleep."
Why Zandvoort exposes some fundamental Red Bull problems

Aside from Verstappen’s physical condition, Red Bull is also struggling for performance at the circuit in the dunes. The home hero had to settle for seventh on the grid and was more than four tenths behind polesitter Lando Norris in qualifying.
"We changed quite a lot on the car after the sprint, but none of it made any difference," Verstappen said when asked by Motorsport.com.
According to Verstappen, the Zandvoort circuit exposes some of Red Bull’s weaknesses to an exaggerated degree
"The balance of the car is the biggest problem. It’s just not consistent throughout the entire corner, but it has been like that all season. It’s just a little worse at some circuits than at others."
In that respect, Zandvoort is a track that exposes the RB22’s weaknesses more than most.

"It depends on the tarmac sometimes, but also on the layout of the track. This one is for sure not our best layout, but we just need to work on it. We can guess on what track it might be a little bit better, but we need to try and just dial it out."

Verstappen added that, in his view, it is not so much related to set-up, as Red Bull has tried everything in that respect: "I think we’re now simply more limited by some fundamental problems with the car that we need to solve.

"At this circuit you also have some fast corners and we’re lacking there as well. In general, if you don’t have a good balance, you can’t really attack the corners. And if you don’t have traction either, you can’t get out of the corners properly, so all of that costs time."
It means Verstappen considers seventh place the maximum achievable result on Sunday under normal circumstances, particularly if there is no chaos caused by rain.
Without rain, Verstappen reckons that P7 will be the best he can hope for in his final home race
It may not be the Zandvoort farewell he had hoped for, although the four-time world champion stresses that the Dutch GP era as a whole has already been a great success.

"It’s absolutely the end of an era," he said. "To have had your own home race and to have been able to win it a few times is very special. Of course, it’s a shame that it’s going away, but on the other hand, it has also given me a lot of great moments and memories."
Whether another memorable moment will be added remains to be seen, but Verstappen took a pragmatic view in conclusion.

"I’m really only satisfied when we win, but that’s going to be very difficult tomorrow," he said. "We’ve been a little too slow throughout this season and that’s not suddenly going to change in Zandvoort, but we’re just going to try to enjoy it one last time."

detailZh: 利亚姆·劳森：我一直知道2025年本可以有所不同——现在你们也知道了
在受伤的伊萨克·哈贾尔缺阵的情况下，利亚姆·劳森替补参加一级方程式荷兰大奖赛，他在这次临时回归红牛的比赛中表现出色，排位赛成绩紧咬队友马克斯·维斯塔潘
距离他在一级方程式中为红牛效力那段只跑了两位比赛、堪称灾难性的短暂时期已经过去十八个月，利亚姆·劳森画上了一个圆满的句号，兑现了他一直说自己会兑现的承诺。
由于维斯塔潘的常规队友哈贾尔因手腕受伤缺阵，劳森从小红牛被召回，在赞德沃特周末驾驶这位法国车手的小红牛22赛车出战。
对于红牛来说，这是最合乎逻辑的选择，因为劳森相比新秀队友阿尔维德·林德布拉德拥有丰富的F1经验，相比替补车手角田裕毅也更了解2026年的赛车，而角田则转而进入了小红牛（小红牛）。
对劳森来说，感觉赌注要大得多。在继续为自己争取F1长期未来的过程中，赞德沃特是一个出乎意料的机会，让他可以弥补第一次效力红牛期间犯下的错误——那段经历在2025年初仅持续了两场比赛，就被时任车队领队克里斯蒂安·霍纳和车手顾问赫尔穆特·马科毫无体面地用角田换了下来。
就像重回赛场、效力于姊妹车队的角田一样，劳森把赞德沃特的冲刺赛环节当作常规比赛周末的一部分来对待，以此为自己在周六下午的大奖赛排位赛积蓄状态。
劳森没费太大力气就晋级了前十名排位决战（shootout），他在第三节排位赛（Q3）跑出的1分11.733秒让他排在发车位的第八位。这一圈比杆位慢了0.570秒，但关键的是，只比队友维斯塔潘慢了十分之一秒，而红牛在荷兰人的主场正苦于速度不足。这与他在2025年澳大利亚大奖赛红牛首秀时排位第18、次周在中国排位第20的表现相比，已是天壤之别。
当Motorsport.com问劳森在赞德沃特紧紧咬住维斯塔潘有多么令人满意时，他说：“要在很短的时间内努力提升状态非常具有挑战性，但显然目标就是整个周末不断进步。大家做得非常好，帮助我在赛车里尽可能感到舒适。我感觉我几乎把赛车的所有潜力都榨出来了。
“作为车手，我们都有很强的自信，所以我没有抱太高的期望，只是尽力做好最充分的准备。鉴于今年赛车的速度，我只是尽量紧跟马克斯，并努力从他做的事情中学习。今天我们执行得很好。”
尽管把一项复杂的运动简化成简单的因果关系很诱人，但劳森在赞德沃特的近乎完美的表现——与他在红牛一级方程式赛车首秀时的截然相反的结果——不可能归结为单一因素。
当时的环境不可能相差更多了，上赛季初劳森从第一天起就处于被动，驾驶着一辆难以驾驭的小红牛21。他此前从未在墨尔本或上海比赛过，还没来得及站稳脚跟就接到了走人的通知。而且红牛之前的管理层似乎从来没有真正相信过劳森，只是对他的信任略多于角田裕毅而已。
劳森解释说：“去年显然非常接近，因为那些赛车处于规则的最后一年，所以已经被完全开发到极限了。总的来说，那辆车非常难开，而且我从未去过墨尔本和中国。中国是冲刺赛周末，那几个周末发生了很多对我们不利的事情，然后就那样了。”
2026年这一代F1赛车也起到了帮助作用，因为在排位赛中更容易达到极限，而且红牛最新的赛车不像之前那辆难以驾驭的前代车型那样处于刀锋边缘。但是，除了使用相同的红牛福特动力单元之外，劳森发现小红牛22与VCARB 03相比是一辆完全不同的赛车。
他解释说：“我能描述的最好方式是，除了动力单元之外，每一件东西的感觉都不一样。转向的感觉与赛车的动态表现、过弯时的平衡，当然还有高速抓地力，一切都不一样。”
将他现在的赞德沃特赛车与2025年的红牛相比，他说：“那是指把赛车扔进弯角，并且知道和感觉到它会做出什么反应。去年，这辆赛车至少在赛季初处于如此刀锋般的边缘，如果你没有达到那个极限，就会损失大量的圈速，而今年有更多的因素在起作用。”
不过，规格不同的不仅仅是赛车。2025年初的那个劳森，和在荷兰大奖赛面对更换赛车这一艰巨任务的这个劳森，也不是同一个版本。在拥有了一年半的经验之后，这位24岁的车手感觉自己准备得更充分了，作为红牛二队（小红牛）的车手，他已经变得更全面。
这位新西兰车手指出：“我也学到了很多，只是一些个人的东西。去年刚进入车队时，我显然以为自己会有更多时间在赛车里——所以当时我基本上是在适应马克斯在赛车中拥有的一切。
“如果有更多时间，我显然觉得自己本可以适应那辆赛车。但来到这个周末，我已经参加了很多场一级方程式（Formula 1）比赛。除此之外，就是多了一些经验，帮助我为这个周末做准备。”
如果说有一个关于劳森的定性是他最反对的，那就是他的首次红牛之旅的失败是因为缺乏信心，这是当时人们的说法。劳森一直反驳这种说法，并表示他只是需要更多的驾驶时间。在赞德沃特，用一些事实来支持这一点，感觉很好。
“这太棒了，”他点点头说。“我一直都知道，如果情况不同，事情本来会有不同的结果。但也许对你们大家以及对全世界来说，现在你们也能看到了。”
detailEn: Liam Lawson: I always knew 2025 could have been different - now you do too
Subbing for the injured Isack Hadjar at Formula 1's Dutch Grand Prix, Liam Lawson shone on his one-off Red Bull return by shadowing team-mate Max Verstappen in qualifying
Eighteen months on from a calamitous two-race stint with Red Bull in Formula 1, Liam Lawson came full circle by delivering on the promise he always said he would.
With Verstappen's regular team-mate Hadjar sidelined by a wrist injury, Lawson was recalled from satellite team Racing Bulls to step into the Frenchman's RB22 for the Zandvoort weekend.

For Red Bull, it was the most logical choice given Lawson's extensive F1 experience compared to rookie team-mate Arvid Lindblad, and his knowledge of the 2026 cars compared to reserve driver Yuki Tsunoda, who slotted in at Racing Bulls instead.

For Lawson, it felt like there was a lot more at stake. As he continues to stake his claim for a long-term F1 future, Zandvoort was an unexpected opportunity to right the wrongs of his first Red Bull stint, which lasted all of two races at the start of 2025 before being unceremoniously swapped with Tsunoda by then team boss Christian Horner and driver advisor Helmut Marko.

Like series returnee Tsunoda at the sister team, Lawson treated Zandvoort's sprint sessions as if they were part of a regular weekend to build himself up for grand prix qualifying on Saturday afternoon.

Having advanced to the top 10 shoot-out without too much trouble, Lawson's Q3 lap of 1m11.733s yielded eighth on the grid. That lap was 0.570s off pole but, crucially, only a tenth behind team-mate Verstappen as Red Bull struggled for pace on the Dutchman's home soil. A world away from qualifying 18th on his Red Bull debut at the 2025 Australian Grand Prix and 20th the following week in China.

"It's been very challenging to try and build up in a short space of time, but obviously the target was to keep improving through the weekend," Lawson said when asked by Motorsport.com how satisfying it was to stick close to Verstappen in Zandvoort. "It was a good job from everybody to help me get me as comfortable as possible in the car. I feel like I extracted pretty much everything I had out of the car.

"As drivers we all have plenty of self-belief, so without expecting too much I tried to be as prepared as possible. Knowing the speed of the car this year, I just was trying to get as close to Max as possible and try to learn from what he was doing. Today we executed well."

As tempting as it is to distil a complex sport down to a simple cause and effect, it's impossible to pin Lawson's squeaky clean Zandvoort performance - the opposite outcome of his first go in a Red Bull F1 car - to a singular factor.

The circumstances couldn't have been much more different, with Lawson on the back foot from day one at the start of last season in a difficult to drive RB21. Having never driven at either Melbourne or Shanghai before, Lawson was never able to get his feet under the table before being given his marching orders. It also never felt like Red Bull's previous management truly believed in Lawson, only that it had more faith in him than in Tsunoda.

"Last year it was obviously extremely close, because the cars were in the last year of the regulations, so they were fully developed," Lawson explained. "Overall, the car was very difficult to drive and on top of that, I'd never been to Melbourne and China. China was a sprint weekend, there's plenty of things that happened over those weekends that didn't help us and then that was it."

The 2026 generation of F1 cars has also helped, as it has become easier to get to the limit in qualifying and Red Bull's latest car is less of a knife-edge than its recalcitrant predecessor. But other than sharing the same power unit from Red Bull Ford Powertrains, Lawson found the RB22 to be a completely different car compared to the VCARB 03.

"The best way I can describe it is that outside of the power unit every single thing feels different," he explained. "The way the steering feels versus how the car moves, balance through corners, obviously the high-speed grip, everything's different about it.

Comparing his Zandvoort machine to the 2025 Red Bull, he said: "It's throwing a car into a corner and knowing and feeling what it's going to do. Last year, the car was on such a knife edge at least at the start that if you weren't on that limit then it was a huge lap time killer and this year there are so many more factors."

It's not just the car that's of a different specification, though. That early 2025 version of Lawson also wasn't the same spec as the one facing the uphill task to change cars at the Dutch Grand Prix. With a season-and-a-half of experience under his belt, the 24-year-old felt better prepared and has become a more complete package as a driver at Racing Bulls.

"I've also learnt a lot, just personal things," the New Zealander pointed out. "I went into last year, obviously thinking I was going to have more time in the car - so I was more or less adapting to everything that Max had in the car.

"With more time obviously I feel like I would have adjusted to the car. But coming into this weekend, I've had a lot more races in Formula 1. Outside of that, it's just having a bit more experience trying to prepare this weekend."

If there's one characterisation Lawson has fought against the most, then it's that the failure of his first Red Bull foray was down to a lack of confidence, as was suggested at the time. Lawson always challenged that line and said he just needed more seat time. It felt good to back that up with some facts in Zandvoort.
"It's great," he nodded. "It's something I've always known that with different circumstances, things would have gone differently. But maybe to you guys and to the world, now you can see it as well."

detailZh: 我们评选出了在赞德沃特举行的竞争激烈、差距微小的2026年荷兰大奖赛一级方程式排位赛中的赢家和输家。
输家：阿斯顿·马丁本田车队（第18名和第19名）
相比冲刺排位赛确实有进步，但排位赛结束后，最能说明问题的还是兰斯·斯特罗尔对本田进步幅度的评价。
他称这只是一次“小步前进”，并表示“远远不够”。
此外，它还带来了不理想的驾驶性问题，这些问题最早在亨格罗林拍摄日的首秀上就被发现。这意味着车手们在入弯时无法确定自己会有多少动力，也不知道会不会像阿隆索在周五的排位赛第一阶段（SQ1）中那样被直接甩出赛道。
“这就像抽彩票。现在我们就是得不到一致性的发动机制动，入弯时还出现很多被拒绝的降挡。所以，是的，问题很多。”斯特罗尔这样总结道。
这些驾驶性问题需要回到位于日本樱市的本田总部去解决，而不是在赛道边。因此，指望在蒙扎之前有所改善是不现实的——而到了蒙扎，问题可能会更加严重。
两位车手都对阿斯顿·马丁在匈牙利站底盘方面取得的进步赞不绝口，但据车手们说，目前第二版本田引擎还没能跟上这个进步。——乔什·萨蒂尔
卫冕冠军拿下了连续第二个杆位，也是2026赛季第二个非梅赛德斯车队的杆位——周六下午在赞德福特，他挡住了两位梅赛德斯车手。
当Q3尾声下起雨时，诺里斯挡住了乔治·拉塞尔，当时这位梅赛德斯车手在他后视镜中逼近，试图完成超越以获得干净空气。在Q3中保持在梅赛德斯之前的位置，对诺里斯的杆位单圈起到了关键作用。
“没有比这更好的了，说实话有点惊讶。一圈不错的成绩，我全力推进了，你们也看到了差距有多小，每一百分之一秒都可能决定胜负，”他说。“相比之前我们感觉有点挣扎的表现，这是一个不错的转变。”
鉴于自2021年赞德福特回归赛历以来，荷兰大奖赛的冠军均由杆位发车者获得，这一转变可能至关重要。——萨马特·卡纳尔
在赞德沃特的五个排位赛阶段中，利亚姆·劳森平均比马克斯·维斯塔潘慢0.128秒。这可是马克斯·维斯塔潘啊！如果你是劳森或者他的粉丝，这个成绩基本上值得开个派对庆祝一下。
在其中两个阶段，他击败了维斯塔潘，而在最后一个计入成绩的阶段，他只慢了0.115秒。
维斯塔潘几乎是不可能击败的。这辆红牛赛车非常难以驾驭。但尽管如此，劳森在缺乏准备的情况下顶替伊萨克·哈贾尔出场，仍然找到了证明自己实力的方式。
考虑到他第一次效力红牛车队时的糟糕表现，你就能理解为什么没人把他和正式回归厂队联系在一起。但抛开这一点不谈，他在这种情况下已经做到了车手所能期望的最好水平。——杰克·贝尼翁
法拉利的排位赛魔咒仍在继续，这支车队就是没能在周六找到状态。
汉密尔顿和勒克莱尔在排位赛速度上的竞争力非常强，周六下午两人的差距仅有0.064秒——而在此前周五的冲刺排位赛中，两人相差接近六分之一秒（0.6秒）。但这已经是法拉利能拿到的最好的消息了。
勒克莱尔解释说，法拉利在从第二节排位赛（Q2）到第三节排位赛（Q3）更换模式时“出现了错误，也就是动力模式的切换”。
“这让我对赛车的手感受到了一些影响，我们需要研究一下，”他说。“但我认为无论如何，本来也不具备争夺杆位的潜力。”
汉密尔顿将排位赛的不佳表现归咎于轮胎升温不足，但他希望法拉利强劲的正赛节奏能带来一些安慰。
只要起步顺利，车队（Scuderia，即法拉利）至少能在周九跟住领先集团的尾部——不过考虑到赞德沃特很难超车，登上领奖台可能有些勉强。 - SK
周五冲刺赛排位赛中，皮埃尔·加斯利的升级版阿尔派领跑中游车队引发了大量热议，但一天后的正式排位赛上，加斯利却一头雾水，止步于第二节排位赛（Q2）。
“如果那已经是绝对最佳的一圈、一切感觉都很棒、而我们只差0.1秒，那才会更令人担忧。我只是觉得目前一切还没有完全协调好。”这是加斯利对当前局面的乐观解读。
显然这些升级是一个进步，但阿尔派还没有完全弄清楚如何将它们的潜力发挥到极致。这很令人恼火，因为冲刺赛已经表明排位赛在这里有多重要，而且考虑到超车难度，明天的正赛将会很艰难，至少想追平加斯利在冲刺赛中的第八名并不容易。
但最终他说得对，这里没有必要恐慌。这只不过是因为升级套件很早就在一辆车上率先引入，车手们对其缺乏经验而已。——简森·巴顿
周四在非常严厉地批评了哈斯赛车的发展之后，奥利·比尔曼又在赞德沃特连续两次于一阶段排位（Q1）中出局，都排在了队友身后，周六更是拿到第二十位，这是他本赛季至今最差的成绩。
“冲刺赛之后我们做了一些小的调整，但说实话，我们其实能做的并不多，”比尔曼说。
“我们最后总是只能跑同样的配置，因为这是我们唯一能从赛车上榨出一点残余性能的办法，是的，这根本不管用。”
埃斯特班·奥康指出了本周末影响贝尔曼的零件一致性问题，这意味着“每次你把车放下，就像抛硬币，一辆车能用，另一辆车不能用”。
第一节排位赛中，博托莱托在一号弯出弯时发生了一次严重打滑，差点提前结束他的排位赛——但他不仅稳住了，随后还表现出色。
“我不知道自己在干什么，”他在压到太多路缘石后不得不重新稳住时，在无线电里大声喊道。
这位巴西车手在第一节排位赛（Q1）中恢复状态拿到第10名，随后在第二节排位赛（Q2）中比队友尼克·霍肯伯格快了0.3秒。
他承认那是一个“可怕的时刻”——而且在接下来的阶段他差点再次遭遇——他把第一节排位赛的失误归因于赞德福特赛道周围的阵风。
这位奥迪车队的车手的排位成绩还超过了小红牛的阿尔维德·林德布拉德（第10名）以及驾驶升级版赛车的加斯利（第11名）。
在冲刺赛中与积分失之交臂后，博尔托莱托现在有机会在四个周末中第三次拿到积分。——天空体育
detailEn: Our picks for the winners and losers from a highly competitive and close F1 qualifying session for the 2026 Dutch Grand Prix at Zandvoort.
Loser: Aston Martin Honda (18th and 19th)
Progress from sprint qualifying, no doubt, but it was Lance Stroll’s verdict on Honda’s step forward that was most telling after qualifying.
He called it a “small step” and said it’s “not nearly enough”.

Plus, it’s also created unwanted driveability issues that were first flagged in the Hungaroring filming day debut. It means the drivers are heading into corner entries uncertain of how much power they’ll have, and whether they’ll be fired off the road like Fernando Alonso was in SQ1 on Friday.
“It's a lottery. Right now we're just not getting the consistent engine braking, going into the corner and a lot of rejected downshifts. So, yeah, a lot of issues,” was Stroll’s summary.
Those driveability issues need to be solved back at Honda HQ in Sakura, Japan, rather than trackside. So it’s unrealistic to expect improvements until Monza - where it could be even more punishing.
Both drivers were effusive about the step with the chassis Aston Martin made in Hungary, but right now, according to the drivers, the spec 2 Honda hasn’t matched that. - Josh Suttill
The reigning champion took his second-straight pole position and the second non-Mercedes pole position of 2026 - holding off both Mercedes drivers on Saturday afternoon in Zandvoort.

As the rain fell at the end of Q3, Norris held George Russell off as the Mercedes driver loomed in his wing mirrors, looking to overtake and gain clean air. That spot ahead of the Mercedes in Q3 proved pivotal to Norris’s pole lap.

“It doesn't get any better, a little surprised honestly. A decent lap, I was pushing as you've seen how close it is, every one-hundredth can make a difference,” he said. “A good turnaround from earlier where I felt we struggled a little bit."
This turnaround could prove crucial given that since Zandvoort returned in 2021, the Dutch Grand Prix has been won from pole position. - Samarth Kanal

Over five qualifying segments, Liam Lawson was an average of 0.128s off Max Verstappen at Zandvoort. Max Verstappen! It’s a result basically worth throwing a party for if you’re Lawson or one of his fans.
In two of those segments he beat Verstappen, and in the final one that counted, he was 0.115s off.
Verstappen’s almost impossible to beat. This Red Bull is so tough to drive. But still, Lawson has found a way to be relevant despite his lack of preparation stepping in for Isack Hadjar.

After how badly his first Red Bull stint went, you can understand why nobody is linking him with a permanent return to the works team. But that aside, he’s done about as well as you’d expect any driver to in these circumstances. - Jack Benyon
Ferrari’s qualifying hoodoo continues as the team just can’t get it going on Saturdays.

Hamilton and Leclerc are incredibly competitive on qualifying pace and were split by just 0.064s on Saturday afternoon - having been almost six-tenths apart in Friday’s sprint qualifying. But that’s really as positive as it gets.
Leclerc explained that Ferrari made “mistakes in changing modes, power modes from Q2 to Q3.
“That put me off a little bit with the feeling I had with the car and we'll have to look into it," he said. "But I don't think the potential for pole position was there anyway.”
Hamilton pointed towards poor tyre warm-up for his qualifying woes, but hopes Ferrari’s strong race pace can provide the consolation.
With a solid start, the Scuderia could at least stay on the tail of the leading pack on Sunday - although the podium might be a stretch given how hard it is to overtake at Zandvoort. - SK

There was a lot of hype about the upgraded Alpine of Pierre Gasly leading the midfield in sprint qualifying on Friday, but fast-forward to qualifying proper a day later and Gasly was left perplexed and out in Q2.

“If it was the absolute best lap and everything felt amazing and we're a tenth off, then it would be more concerning. I just think things didn't quite click yet,” was Gasly’s glass-half-full take on the situation.

Clearly the upgrades are a step forward, but Alpine hasn’t worked out exactly how to get the best out of them. That’s annoying as the sprint race showed how important qualifying is here, and the race will be tough tomorrow in terms of overtaking, at least to match Gasly’s P8 from the sprint race.
But he’s right ultimately that there’s no need to panic here. It’s just a case of inexperience with an upgrade package introduced early on one car only. - JB

After being very critical of Haas’s car development on Thursday, Ollie Bearman followed that up with two Q1 exits behind his team-mate at Zandvoort, bagging 20th on Saturday, which was his worst result of the season so far.
“We did a few small changes [after the sprint], but there's not really much that we can do, to be honest with you,” Bearman said.
“We always end up running the same configuration, because it's the only way we can get any remnants of performance out of the car, and yeah, it's just not worked.”
Esteban Ocon pointed to the parts inconsistency issues affecting Bearman this weekend, which means "Every time you put a car down, you flip a coin and one car will work, one car will not".
A huge slide at the exit of Turn 1 in Q1 nearly ended Bortoleto’s qualifying session early - yet he recovered, and then some.
“I don’t know what I’m doing,” he exclaimed on the radio after he took too much of the kerbs and had to reset.
The Brazilian driver recovered to 10th in Q1 and then went three-tenths faster than team-mate Nico Hulkenberg in Q2.
He conceded it was a “scary moment” - and he almost repeated it in the following sessions - attributing his Q1 moment to the gusts around Zandvoort.
The Audi driver also outqualified Racing Bulls’s Arvid Lindblad (P10) and the upgraded Alpine of Gasly (P11).
Having missed out on a point in the sprint, Bortoleto now has a chance to score points for the third time in four weekends. - SK

items.summaryEn: After Dutch Grand Prix qualifying, a radio exchange between Max Verstappen and his Red Bull engineer Gianpiero Lambiase went viral, in which Verstappen predicted George Russell would complain about the pit release, but the complaint never came.
detailZh: 马克斯·维斯塔潘（维斯塔潘）关于乔治·拉塞尔（拉塞尔）的无线电玩笑在荷兰大奖赛排位赛后走红
马克斯·维斯塔潘在荷兰大奖赛排位赛期间关于乔治·拉塞尔的无线电玩笑已经走红
四届F1世界冠军马克斯·维斯塔潘发给他的红牛比赛工程师詹皮耶罗·兰比亚斯（Gianpiero Lambiase）的一条车队无线电信息，在赞德沃特的荷兰大奖赛排位赛后走红。
在排位赛期间，维斯塔潘预料到了梅赛德斯车手乔治·拉塞尔会提出投诉，但投诉实际上并没有出现。当车手们驶出维修区通道时，这位荷兰车手说：“我们可能会听到乔治在无线电里为维修区放行哭诉，但那其实一点也不危险。”
就转播画面所展示的内容来看，这位梅赛德斯车手并没有像维斯塔潘开玩笑预测的那样抱怨放车问题。
"什么都没做。被讨厌了。学学乔治吧，"一位车迷在Reddit上评论道，而另一位则补充说："大概是开玩笑吧，但我觉得如果乔治这么说的话，应该就不会被认为好笑了……"
"当拉塞尔的无线电打开时，维斯塔潘有点尴尬，因为他问的其实是天气。那些他过去用来挑衅的人已经比他更成熟了，不再上他那些把戏的当，"另一位车迷发帖说。
还有人评论道："抱怨对手可能会抱怨刚刚发生的情况，结果那位对手根本没抱怨。这是26年我最喜欢的一条信息，干得好GR。"
进一步的反应包括：“我确实喜欢Max的车队无线电，因为我喜欢GP一直保持冷静的样子，Max太搞笑了哈哈”，以及“我喜欢Max的俏皮劲儿”。另一条评论写道：“Max实在太逗了。”
迈凯伦的诺里斯拿下荷兰大奖赛杆位，Russell将与他共同排在头排。Verstappen排位第七，他的队友劳森——他顶替受伤的哈贾尔出战——将在第八位与他并肩发车。
荷兰大奖赛将于8月23日星期日下午3点（英国时间下午2点）举行。
detailEn: Max Verstappen's George Russell radio joke goes viral after Dutch GP qualifying
Max Verstappen's radio joke about George Russell during Dutch Grand Prix qualifying has gone viral
A team radio message from four-time Formula 1 champion Max Verstappen to his Red Bull race engineer Gianpiero Lambiase has gone viral after qualifying for the Dutch Grand Prix at Zandvoort.

During the qualifying session, Verstappen anticipated a complaint from Mercedes rival George Russell, which never actually came. As the drivers made their way out of the pitlane, the Dutchman said, "We'll probably have George crying on the radio about the pit release, but it was nothing unsafe."
As far as what was shown on the broadcast, the Mercedes driver did not complain about the pit release as Verstappen had jokingly predicted.
"Does nothing. Got hated. Be like George," one fan commented on Reddit, while another added: "Banter ig, but I bet it wouldn't be considered as funny if George said it..."

"It was a bit embarrassing for Verstappen when Russell's radio turned on, and he asked about the weather instead. The guys he used to bait just matured more than him and don't fall for his games anymore," another fan posted.
Someone else commented: "Complaining that a rival will probably complain about a scenario that just occurred, only for that rival not to complain. My favourite message of 26, well done GR."
Further reactions included: "I do like a Max radio just because I like how calm GP is all the time, very funny from Max lol," and "I love sassy Max." Another comment read: "Max is too funny."

McLaren's Lando Norris secured pole position for the Dutch Grand Prix and will be joined by Russell on the front row. Verstappen qualified seventh and his team-mate Liam Lawson, who has stepped in for an injured Isack Hadjar, will line up beside him in eighth.
The Dutch Grand Prix will take place at 3pm local time (2pm UK time) on Sunday 23 August.

items.originalTitle: 汉密尔顿称法拉利小改动带来“难以置信”的提升
items.summaryEn: Lewis Hamilton said a significant improvement in his Ferrari's balance left him more optimistic for the Dutch Grand Prix after qualifying fifth, while team mate Charles Leclerc was less happy after taking sixth on the grid.
detailZh: 刘易斯·汉密尔顿在排位赛中显著改善了法拉利赛车的平衡性后，对荷兰大奖赛的前景感到乐观。
他说，在排位赛中获得第五名后，他惊讶地发现赛车的感觉好了很多，而当天早些时候的冲刺赛中他仅获得第七名。
“我对赛车满意多了，”汉密尔顿说。“说实话，这太疯狂了。我们改变了很多东西，看起来并不大，但它在赛车中产生的差异令人难以置信。”
汉密尔顿表示，在冲刺赛排位赛之前，他在周末开始时对赛车感到满意。
“困难的是，我以第一名的成绩开始，信心十足，但在[冲刺赛]排位赛中我完全失去了信心，整个比赛过程中我对平衡性毫无信心。它不断地甩开我。
“然后我进入[大奖赛]排位赛，赛车就在那里，所以至少平衡性在那里。所以我一直在建立、建立、建立。[如果我们有]更多圈数，我想我们可能做得更好，但我认为最终轮胎是我们的问题。”
这位法拉利车手表示，他对“明天拥有这样的平衡性感到乐观得多”。
然而，他的队友查尔斯·勒克莱尔在冲刺赛中获得第二名后，对大奖赛排位赛仅获得第六名感到不太满意。
“我们真的必须看两件事，”他说。“第一件主要是我们从Q1到Q2再到Q3开始改变引擎模式。然后赛车在我下面做着不同的事情，这不是我喜欢的，我们可能在那里错过了一些性能。
“第二是我们所做的准备圈，其他人似乎没有做。我觉得如果没有那个准备圈，我的轮胎不会准备好，但我们必须保持开放的心态，看看其他人做了什么。”
detailEn: Lewis Hamilton is optimistic about his chances in the Dutch Grand Prix after making a significant improvement in his Ferrari’s balance in qualifying.
He said he was surprised how much better his car felt on his way to fifth on the grid in qualifying after finishing seventh in the sprint race earlier today.
“I’m so much happier with the car,” said Hamilton. “Honestly, it’s crazy. We changed a lot of things, it doesn’t really look that big, but the difference it makes in the car is unbelievable.”
Hamilton said he felt happy with the car at the beginning of the weekend before qualifying for the sprint race.

“The difficult thing is I started P1 with good confidence, I lost it all in [sprint race] qualifying and all through the race I had no confidence in the balance. It was constantly breaking away from me.

“Then I go into [grand prix] qualifying and the car’s there, so the balance is there at least. So I was building and building and building. [If we had] some more laps I think we could have probably done better but I think ultimately the tyres were the issue for us.”
The Ferrari driver said he feels “a lot more optimistic for tomorrow with the balance that I have.”
However his team mate Charles Leclerc, who finished second in the sprint race, was less happy after taking sixth on the grid for the grand prix.

“We’ll have to look at two things, really,” he said. “The first one is mostly the fact that we started changing engine modes from Q1 to Q2 to Q3. Then the car is just doing different things underneath me, which is not something I enjoy, and we’ve probably missed a bit of performance there.

“Second is the prep[aration] lap that we have done that the others seem to not have done. I don’t feel like my tyres would have been ready without that preparation lap, but we’ve got to be open-minded and look at what the others have done.”
keyPointsZh: 汉密尔顿在冲刺赛排位和正赛中缺乏信心，赛车平衡不断失控，但大奖赛排位赛中平衡恢复。
勒克莱尔对排位赛第六名不满，指出引擎模式从Q1到Q3的切换让赛车表现不一致，且他做的准备圈可能影响了轮胎状态。
keyPointsEn: Hamilton lacked confidence in the car's balance during sprint qualifying and the sprint race, but the balance returned in grand prix qualifying.
Leclerc was unhappy with sixth on the grid, noting that switching engine modes from Q1 to Q3 made the car behave differently and that his preparation lap may have affected his tyres.

detailEn: F1 Dutch GP: Sunday schedule, weather forecast and how to watch
What time the 2026 Formula 1 Dutch Grand Prix starts, plus the full Zandvoort schedule, weather forecast and how to watch live
Lewis Hamilton, Ferrari, Max Verstappen, Red Bull Racing
Formula 1 heads into Sunday at Zandvoort with Lando Norris on pole after beating George Russell in qualifying for the Dutch Grand Prix.

The McLaren driver took his second pole of the 2026 season by 0.102s, with championship leader Kimi Antonelli third and Oscar Piastri fourth. Lewis Hamilton starts fifth ahead of Charles Leclerc, while Max Verstappen lines up seventh for his final home grand prix at Zandvoort.
Sunday’s race could be shaped by track position, tyre behaviour and the difficulty of overtaking around Zandvoort’s fast, narrow layout. Here is everything you need to know ahead of the Dutch GP.

For viewers in the United Kingdom, Sky Sports continues as the championship’s exclusive broadcaster, showing every session live throughout the 2026 season. F1 coverage can also be streamed via Sky Go or NOW, with highlights available free-to-air on Channel 4.

items.originalTitle: 安东内利对荷兰大奖赛杆位失误感到沮丧
items.summaryEn: Formula 1 championship leader Kimi Antonelli was frustrated after a mistake at Turn 1 cost him pole position in Dutch Grand Prix qualifying, leaving the Mercedes driver to start third. He qualified 0.133s behind McLaren polesitter Lando Norris and 0.031s behind team-mate George Russell.
detailZh: 安东内利 在1号弯的"失误"让他错失荷兰大奖赛杆位后感到沮丧
这位梅赛德斯车手将从第三位发车，参加周日的荷兰大奖赛，排在 诺里斯 和队友 拉塞尔 之后
安东内利 对自己在荷兰大奖赛排位赛中的表现感到沮丧，这位F1积分榜领跑者因在1号弯的失误而错失杆位。
这位梅赛德斯车手排位赛成绩比迈凯轮杆位得主 诺里斯 慢0.133秒，比排名第二的队友 拉塞尔 慢0.031秒，因此将从第三位发车，参加周日在赞德沃特举行的比赛。
安东内利认为自己“本来有机会争夺杆位”，但在Q3末段雨水即将来临时——他在第一轮跑出第四后——进入1号弯发卡弯时收油收得太多了。
“我在第一个计时段损失了两分之几秒，所以很遗憾，”这位19岁的车手告诉天空体育意大利台。“这是一场艰难的排位赛：我很难找到合适的感觉，尤其是车尾方面。
“这是那种我们完全没有动车的排位赛之一，通常随着排位赛进行，你会开始加大尾翼来帮助车子更好地转向。
“今天情况并非如此，因为我依然很挣扎，但我相信在Q3我有机会去争夺杆位。”
“遗憾的是，我在1号弯犯了一个错误，尤其是看到下雨后，可以说我进弯太慢了，损失了很多时间。所以这是我自己的失误，但最终还是拿到了第三名。”
诺里斯（迈凯伦）、拉塞尔（梅赛德斯）、安东内利（梅赛德斯）
对这位意大利车手来说，这个本已令人失望的周末还在继续，他在周五的冲刺赛排位赛中因SQ1倒数第二个弯角冲出赛道而遭遇底板受损。
这让他损失了“25分”的下压力，导致他在周六的正赛中仅排第五位发车，最终获得第四名，落后于冠军Russell、法拉利的勒克莱尔和Norris。
“我犯了一个错误，这肯定让我失去了一些信心，”安东内利说。“而且今天的排位赛也是，主要是我对这辆车的感觉不太好。我仍然很难找到自己的节奏，把单圈时间做好。”
但周日——这将是最後一届荷兰大奖赛——给了安东内利一个反弹的机会，他可以将自己与第五位发车的刘易斯·汉密尔顿之间53分的积分领先优势进一步扩大。
“取得一个好的发车位置肯定很重要，然后尝试给前面的车手施加压力，也许在策略上做一些不同的选择，”领先第三名的拉塞尔56分的安东内利在意大利天空体育的采访中补充道。
“在比赛阶段对轮胎的管理也会很重要，但我必须说，明天我们有一个很好的机会取得好成绩。”
“心态是一样的：进攻，但要动脑子。如果机会出现，就抓住它。否则，就等待并观察局势如何发展。但我绝对不想跑一场防守型的比赛。”
detailEn: Kimi Antonelli frustrated after Turn 1 "mistake" cost him Dutch GP pole
The Mercedes driver will start Sunday's Dutch Grand Prix from third behind Lando Norris and team-mate George Russell
Kimi Antonelli was frustrated with himself after qualifying for the Dutch Grand Prix as the Formula 1 championship leader missed out on pole due to a mistake at Turn 1.
The Mercedes driver will start Sunday’s race at Zandvoort from third after qualifying 0.133s off McLaren polesitter Lando Norris and 0.031s behind team-mate George Russell in second.
Antonelli reckons he “had a shot for pole” but at the end of Q3 when rain was looming - after taking fourth with his first run - he backed off too much heading into the Turn 1 hairpin.

“I lost two tenths [in the first sector], so that's a shame,” the 19-year-old told Sky Sports Italy. “It was a difficult qualifying session: I struggled to find the right feel, especially with the rear.
“It was one of those qualifying sessions where we didn’t touch the car, and usually, as the session progresses, you start adding wing to help it turn more.
“That wasn't the case today because I was still struggling, but I believed that in Q3 I had a chance to contend for it.
“Unfortunately, I made a mistake in Turn 1, especially seeing the rain, let's say I went in too slow and lost a lot of time. So it was a mistake on my part, but it's still a third position.”
Lando Norris, McLaren, George Russell, Mercedes, Andrea Kimi Antonelli, Mercedes
It continued an already disappointing weekend for the Italian, who was suffering from floor damage during Friday’s sprint qualifying after an off at the penultimate corner in SQ1.
That cost him “25 points” of downforce leaving him fifth on the Saturday race grid before eventually finishing fourth, behind winner Russell, Ferrari’s Charles Leclerc and Norris.

“I did a mistake and that definitely took some confidence away,” said Antonelli. “And also today in qualifying, mainly because the feeling was not really there with the car. I still struggled to find my rhythm and to put the lap times together.”
But Sunday - which will mark the final Dutch GP - presents a chance for Antonelli to bounce back and extend his 53-point championship lead over Lewis Hamilton, who starts fifth.

"It will definitely be important to get a good start and then try to put pressure on the drivers ahead, maybe doing something different with the strategy,” added Antonelli, who is 56 points ahead of third-placed Russell, on Sky Sports Italy.
“Tyre management during the stint will also be important, but I have to say that tomorrow we'll have a good chance to get a good result.

“The mindset is the same: on the attack, but using my head. If the opportunity presents, you take it. Otherwise, you wait and see how the situation develops. But I definitely don't want to drive a defensive race.”
